key_insight: Clinical System One (CS1) is a compact AI model for fast clinical-record judgments, supporting record review and trial matching rather than directly discovering cancer drugs.
clinical_relevance: CS1 could help prioritize patients for clinical trial eligibility review, with uncertain judgments routed to humans.
method: Train a 4-billion-parameter model on 12.4 million question–answer pairs from 3.6 million patients.
Answer multiple typed questions per forward pass, with a probability for each answer.
Pair CS1 with a generalist language-model agent to synthesize cited evidence and screen trial criteria.
evidence_signal: On 963,408 held-out patients, CS1 outperformed open decision models up to 27 billion parameters on 13 of 14 independently scored tasks; across 21 external datasets, it approached the strongest tested model with 6.4-fold faster inference.
watch_item: The abstract does not establish prospective clinical benefit or cancer-specific performance; trial eligibility judgments require clinical verification.
paper_title: A general-purpose System One decision model for clinical records
